item.title: Top-ranked Texas Tech sweeps through College Station
item.description: No. 1 Texas Tech softball headed back home to the Lone Star State after opening the season with a three-game stint in Louisiana. The top-ranked squad took part in another three-game slate over the weekend in College Station.

item.title: Lubbock's weekend lineup packed with art, live music and love
item.description: Lubbock, Texas is hosting a variety of events for the weekend of February 6-8, 2026, including art, live music, brunches, Super Bowl watch parties, and activities for all ages.

item.title: Road construction beginning on 13th Street Monday
item.description: The City of Lubbock has announced that beginning Monday, February 13, Barricades Unlimited will close 13th Street, from Avenue L to Avenue M for construction.

item.title: LFR responds to house fire in East Lubbock
item.description: Lubbock Fire Rescue crews responded to a house fire at East 27th Street and MLK Jr Boulevard Sunday afternoon.

item.title: Texas Tech bounces back, tops WVU on the road
item.description: Following its first back-to-back losses of the season, Texas Tech came out firing against West Virginia. The No. 13 Red Raiders were able to climb back into the win column, with a 70-63 win over the Mountaineers in Morgantown.
